title: POV: You Woke Up 200 Years Too Early On A Spaceship

scenes.narration: Your pod opens. The ship is dark. The clock says you're two hundred years from the new planet.
scenes.image_prompt: POV climbing out of a cryo pod on a colossal dark generation spaceship, one clock glowing, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: Four thousand people are asleep around you. They'll never know you're awake.

scenes.image_prompt: POV of a cracked cryo pod with an error screen reading CANNOT RESEAL, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: So you start building. A garden in the cargo bay. A library from the archives.

scenes.image_prompt: POV of an old hand painting a giant mural across a spaceship corridor wall, maps and messages, cinematic first-person POV, photorealistic, Unreal Engine 5 look, volumetric lighting, film grain, vertical 9:16

scenes.narration: Two hundred years later, the colonists wake up to a forest, a city, and one message.
